derivation: from G2095 (εὖ) and a derivative of G5177 (τυγχάνω);
def: well- fated, i.e. fortunate; Eutychus, a young man

occurrences.text: And there sat in a window a certain young man named Eutychus, being fallen into a deep sleep: and as Paul was long preaching, he sunk down with sleep, and fell down from the third loft, and was taken up dead.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
